title: Canva NFT Minter
tagline: Canva NFT Minter allows the Canva users to publish their designs as NFT using the custom Canva Publish app
description: Canva NFT Minter allows the Canva users to publish their designs as NFT using the custom Canva Publish app. The backend for the custom Canva Publish app uploads the design image to IPFS / Filecoin. Then the user is redirected to the Canva NFT Minter frontend where they can mint the ERC 721 NFT and send it to an address. It also has support for Torus and ENS name resolver for the recipient address. The users can also view all the NFTs owned by them. Canva NFT Minter also supports social login using Torus.
